# Measure Findings: CHG-03 Brand Colors
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

The approved brand colors are present in the canonical source and production asset build. Automated checks pass. The result is a conditional local pass because browser visual and responsive evidence has not been recorded.

- Review light mode and dark mode at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.
- Record screenshots or reproducible visual notes before treating CHG-03 as visually accepted.

## Decision Boundary

Measure result: **conditional local pass**. The branded source can continue to browser and staging validation, but this run does not accept the application for release or close the remaining launch gates.
